Use the AI commands

Run the two AI commands set up in LN, read what each answer says, and check it against the screen before acting on it.

Length

Start

Summary

TaskWhat you doResultSteps

Procedure

1Run the stock check

Result
An item's stock in each warehouse and its planned receipts and issues, in one answer that agrees with the item's row.
Screen
Warehousing➔Inventory Reporting➔Inventory Position➔Company - Item Inventory (whwmd4100m100)

Why LN works this way. The command sends the ticked item to the model with its description and unit, its stock in each warehouse and its planned inventory transactions, and nothing else. The answer opens in a window of its own, under the sentence that says what the command does, and can be copied or downloaded from there. The command is on this screen and not on a sales order line, because an order line cannot reach its item's stock. It is kept as a demonstration: LN's own inventory screens show the same figures, and the reason is in Set up a GenAI prompt, Is it worth a prompt.

StepActionYou should see
1.1Open Company - Item InventoryOne row for each item, with its on hand, blocked, on order and allocated figures
1.2Tick the item's rowWrite downon handon order
1.3Open Actions and choose Item Inventory…A window titled Item Inventory, with Check where this item's stock is and what is planned in and out. under Prompt and the answer under Response
1.4Read the first two lines of the answerThe description, the item code in brackets and the unit; then an Attention: line for each warehouse with more allocated than on hand or with stock blocked, or No warnings.
1.5Read each warehouse's sectionIts code and name; ON HAND and BLOCKED on one line; ALLOCATED with the orders going out indented under it; ON ORDER with the orders coming in under it
1.6Read the last lineEmpty: and the warehouses that hold nothing and expect nothing, or no such line
1.7Add up the warehouses' ON HAND, and their ON ORDER, and compare each with step 1.2The sums equal the item's row. Where they do not, act on the row
Run the stock check: if something goes wrong
SymptomWhat to do
Item Inventory… is not in ActionsRead the session code in the status bar. The command is on Company - Item Inventory only, not on Inventory 360, which looks alike
The warehouse lines do not add up to the item's rowAct on the row, not the answer. The model writes only from what LN sent, and a wrong answer reads like a right one

2Run Status Overview

Result
Why a sales order line has not shipped and what step comes next, in one answer that agrees with the line's status screen.
Screen
Sales➔Orders➔Order Intake Workbench (tdsls4601m200)

Why LN works this way. The command sends the ticked line to the model with its blocking records, its activities and its actual deliveries. An activity is a step of the line's ordering process, and LN lists each one with its status on the line's status screen, where the first Free activity is the next to be carried out. The answer gives five parts in a fixed order, and its last sentence names that next step or says the line is canceled.

StepActionYou should see
2.1Open Sales Order Intake Workbench and its Order Lines tabOrder lines from many orders, with a tick box on each
2.2Type your order in the filter box above the Order column and press EnterThat order's lines
2.3Tick the lineWrite downorder and line
2.4Open the Order Lines tab's Actions and choose Status Overview…, near the foot of the menuA window titled Status Overview, with Check why this order line has not shipped and what to do next. under Prompt and the answer under Response
2.5Read the first partThe line: order, line, item, ordered, delivered and back order quantities, planned delivery date, warehouse, and whether it is canceled
2.6Read the second partLine blocked: yes. or Line blocked: no., then a line for each blocking record: hold reason, credit analyst, who blocked it and expected release date
2.7Read the third partOne line for each step that applies to the line, in LN's order, each with its status, such as executed, changed or free
2.8Read the fourth partOne line for each delivery: date, quantity, shipment, shipment line and status. With none, Nothing delivered yet.
2.9Read the last sentenceThe next step and its status, All steps are done., or This line is canceled, so no step is waiting.
2.10Open the line's form by its row iconSales Order Lines opens as a form for that one line
2.11Choose References➔StatusSales Order Line Status opens in a tab of its own
2.12On Activities 1, compare each activity and its status with step 2.7The same steps, each with the same status
2.13Find the first activity whose status is Free and compare it with step 2.9It is the step the answer names, and the one the Execute section names. On a canceled line the answer says no step is waiting, and the Canceled indicator is lit
Run Status Overview: if something goes wrong
SymptomWhat to do
Status Overview… is not in ActionsThe command is on Sales Order Lines opened by itself, step 2.1, and on the Order Lines tab of the workbench. A tab is a screen of its own: a command shows on it only when it is linked to the tab's own code, which the tab's Personalize Form names in the status bar
A step in the answer is a session codeIt is a step outside the four the command names, as What the commands cannot do says
The answer and the status screen disagreeAct on the status screen. It is LN's own record of the line, and the answer is the model's reading of it

Variations

CaseWhat changes
Building a commandSet up a GenAI prompt builds a command like these, improves its answer and removes it
Several lines at onceTick the lines on the Order Lines tab of the workbench and choose Status Overview… once. The answer covers each line in the list's order, with a line of dashes between them. Check each line against its own status screen

Reference

  • A prepared question, attached to a screen. Someone writes the question once, chooses the LN data that goes with it, and links it to one session. Everyone who uses that session then sees it as a command in the Actions menu. Choosing it sends the selected record to the Infor GenAI service, and the answer opens in a window of its own.

    • Answer one fixed question about the record selected

      It does not
      Take a typed question. There is no chat box

    • Read only the data its dataset names

      It does not
      Change anything in LN

    • Open the answer to read, copy or download

      It does not
      Check itself. A wrong answer reads like a right one

    • Status Overview…

      Where
      Sales Order Lines, the line's form, and the Order Lines tab of the Order Intake Workbench

      What it answers
      Why an order line has not shipped, and which step comes next

      Standing
      Run on four lines one at a time, and each answer agreed with the line's status screen. Run on four at once from the workbench, and not yet checked

    • Item Inventory…

      Where
      Company - Item Inventory

      What it answers
      Where an item's stock is, and what is planned in and out

      Standing
      Kept as a demonstration. LN's own inventory screens show the same figures

  • Each command answers one question about the record ticked, from the data LN sends with it.

    • One fixed question

      What it means
      There is nowhere to type your own

    • Four step names

      What it means
      Status Overview names Print Sales Order Acknowledgements/RMAs, Release Sales Orders to Warehousing, Release Sales Orders/Schedules to Invoicing and Process Delivered Sales Orders. Any other step that applies to a line is written as its session code, and no line with such a step has been tried

    • Not tried on a blocked line

      What it means
      The lines Status Overview was checked on were open or canceled, and none was blocked at the time

    • Repeated planned lines

      What it means
      The stock check writes a transaction that repeats once, marked (listed twice)

    • Order type names

      What it means
      The stock check names eight order types; any other prints as its code, and the names are not checked against a source

    • Not in date order

      What it means
      The stock check lists each figure's orders in the order LN sends them

    • Can disagree with the row

      What it means
      One item's warehouses added up to 500 less on hand than its row, so the row is what to act on

    • A demonstration

      What it means
      LN's own inventory screens show what the stock check shows; Status Overview is the one that reads and explains

    • Shared by everyone

      What it means
      The commands are set up once for the screen, so every user of it sees them

  • The GenAI Embedded Experience feature must be switched on for the tenant first, in the CloudSuite Self-Service Portal, by someone with its Admin role. Until it is, no command appears anywhere. Then three things are built, in this order, all under Tools➔Application Extensibility➔Embedded GenAI, and Set up a GenAI prompt walks each one.

    • Dataset

      Session
      Datasets (ttrpi5100m000)

      What it holds
      The data sent: the screen's own table and the fields ticked on it. Nothing else reaches the model

    • Prompt

      Session
      GenAI Prompts (ttrpi5150m000)

      What it holds
      The command's name, its dataset, the text sent to the model, and the sentence the user sees

    • Link

      Session
      GenAI Prompts by Session (ttadv9160m000)

      What it holds
      The one session the command appears on, and when it is enabled

    Then run it and check it, on one record of each kind it can meet, before anyone else relies on it. To remove it, delete the prompt first, which takes its link with it, and the dataset second. The model needs no setup: the service's default answers any prompt that names none.

    • Put the command where the data is

      Why
      A screen's record reaches only some tables. The stock check was wanted on the order line, which cannot reach stock

    • Decide in the dataset, word in the prompt

      Why
      A filter applies a condition the same way every time; a sentence in the prompt is judged afresh on each run

    • Forbid calculating

      Why
      Left free, the model added sums of its own, and one was wrong

    • Say what to write when a value is missing

      Why
      Otherwise the model fills the gap with a confident wrong answer

    • Give the layout

      Why
      Without one, the model chose its own form and changed it between runs

    • Reopen the screen after changing the dataset

      Why
      A screen already open keeps answering from the old dataset. A change to the prompt text shows on the next run

    • Not yet known

      Why
      Where it stands

    • Where the service processes data

      Why
      Not documented for this release.

    • When the service is down

      Why
      Not documented for this release.

    • Authorization levels

      Why
      Not documented for this release.
